spans.s:
m. (-गौः)
1 Heaven, Svarga or paradise.
2 A bull.
3 A ray of light.
4 The thunderbolt.
5 The moon.
6 The sun.
7 A kind of sacrifice, the sacrifice of a cow.
8 The moment of the sun's entering Taurus.
mn. (-गौः-गु)
1 The hair of the body.
2 Water: (in the last sense some confine it to the mas. plu. गावः and according to others, it is neuter in several other senses.)
f. (-गौः)
1 A cow.
2 The eye.
3 An arrow.
4 A quarter, as the east, west, &c.
5 Speech; also identified with the goddess of speech, SARASVATĪ.
6 The earth.
7 A mother.
E.
गम to go, and डो Uṇādi aff.
